title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.12 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 13.12 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to read private CI/CD template files from projects they did not have access to due to missing authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
